title: Successful Treatment of Renal Cell Carcinoma Associated with Hypertrophic Osteopathy in a Cat
caption: Thoracic radiographs in the right lateral (A) and ventral–dorsal position (B). No abnormal findings were observed. Abdominal radiographs in the right lateral (C) and ventral–dorsal position (D). The left kidney was enlarged and slightly displaced ventrally (white arrowhead). The ultrasound examination of the left kidney (E) revealed a hypoechoic renal mass located on the posterior edge of the left kidney (white arrowhead).

title: Liver
caption: A, Thoracic radiography of a 10-year-old mixed-breed dog with a large abdominal mass showing megaesophagus. B, Abdominal ultrasound of the same dog. Hyperechoic mass with hypoechoic areas in the liver. C, Fine-needle cytology of the liver mass, a dense aggregate of large epithelial cells with vacuolated cytoplasm without obvious cytologic criteria of malignancy. A diagnosis of cholangioma or well-differentiated cholangiocarcinoma was made. Histopathologic study of the mass confirmed a cholangioma in this dog.
